binding: A4R-PHYS-MODEL-002 + QWEN_RUNTIME_ROOT_CAUSE_RECEIPT.json (stages 4-7 never ran in the baseline)

chain.name: catalog_selection
chain.guard: pinned catalog entry (identity, revision, sha256, size)

chain.name: download
chain.guard: resumable Range download to <identity>.part; UA set; bounded redirects (5); bounded retries with mirror fallback; size checked against catalog

chain.name: temporary_storage
chain.guard: tmp root, .part suffix, offset == file size on every attempt (no append corruption)

chain.name: sha256_verification
chain.guard: ModelSha256.ofFile(.part) == catalog sha256; mismatch -> QUARANTINED with facts (evidence preserved)

chain.name: gguf_metadata_validation
chain.guard: LOCAL_LLM only: magic GGUF, version 1..3, sane tensor/kv counts

chain.name: atomic_rename_promotion
chain.baseline: NEVER RAN (VoicePackInstaller covered VOICE packs only)

chain.name: installation_registry_update
chain.guard: registry.markInstalled (UPSERT: identity from catalog; installedPath from the move)

chain.name: runtime_registry_update
chain.guard: the LlmRuntime resolves the installed artifact by identity+version (read-back)

chain.name: temporary_file_cleanup
chain.guard: .part deleted ONLY after a verified install (read-back passed)
chain.baseline: NEVER RAN (and the 416 branch DELETED complete partials)

chain.name: read_back
chain.guard: installed file exists && size == installedSizeBytes at the recorded path

chain.name: restart
chain.guard: registry reopen: the record survives (JSON atomic write); the runtime resolver re-resolves from disk

failure_handling.partial_download: partial retained; resume from the ACTUAL file size (Range) — never blind append
failure_handling.network_interruption: bounded retry + one mirror attempt (hf-mirror.com for pinned HF sources); partial retained
failure_handling.hash_mismatch: QUARANTINED with expected/actual facts (GRAPH 4 §7 evidence policy); state FAILED; retry re-downloads
failure_handling.insufficient_space: typed INSUFFICIENT_STORAGE from preflight; partial retained (no install attempted)
failure_handling.invalid_gguf: typed GGUF_INVALID; bytes retained for diagnosis; NEVER marked installed
failure_handling.promotion_interruption: atomic move: either the old state or the new one; the previous version is preserved by installAtomically
failure_handling.registry_write_failure: typed REGISTRY_WRITE_FAILED; the read-back decides the truth (file present = recoverable at restart)
failure_handling.app_crash: the .part survives; on next open the resume path or the 416-recovery path promotes it
failure_handling.duplicate_download: in-flight job per identity; full-partial re-click = 416 recovery (never a second full transfer, never delete)
failure_handling.version_supersession: previous version+sha preserved in the record (rollbackAvailable); rollback controller restores

on_failure_rules: retain only resumable partial data when safe; otherwise clean temporary data
expose exact status (typed Code, never a bare boolean)
activation_note: ACTIVATION stays an explicit Owner action (Tower-first preserved: local LLM optional + OFF by default).
